inspiration.observed_pattern: A grouped workload report combines a descending RANK partition with chronological LEAD values, so tied priority rows keep a shared rank while each row also sees the next workload estimate; a CASE classifies the transition and partition edges expose the missing neighbor.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Rewritten as an independently authored work-item ledger with new names, dates, rows, and output labels. The fixture uses MariaDB-compatible two-argument LEAD, a deterministic date-plus-ID order, nullable DECIMAL estimates, and a separate item-ID LEAD to distinguish an actual next row from a NULL estimate. The source's unrelated tutorial sections and default-argument examples are omitted.

fixture_notes: Team north has tied priority pairs, a NULL current estimate, and a NULL next estimate; team south has a tied lower-priority pair and a terminal row. The item-ID LEAD distinguishes terminal rows from rows whose estimate is NULL.
determinism_notes: Each team has unique (work_day, item_id) ordering keys and all result reads order by team, work_day, item_id. No clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections.
setup: CREATE TABLE work_items (item_id INT PRIMARY KEY, team VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, work_day DATE NOT NULL, priority INT NOT NULL, estimate_hours DECIMAL(7,2) NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT team, work_day, priority, estimate_hours, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY team ORDER BY priority DESC) AS priority_rank, LEAD(estimate_hours, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY team ORDER BY work_day, item_id) AS next_estimate, CASE WHEN LEAD(item_id, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY team ORDER BY work_day, item_id) IS NULL THEN 'no-next' WHEN estimate_hours IS NULL THEN 'current-unknown' WHEN LEAD(estimate_hours, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY team ORDER BY work_day, item_id) IS NULL THEN 'next-unknown' WHEN LEAD(estimate_hours, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY team ORDER BY work_day, item_id) > estimate_hours THEN 'heavier-next' WHEN LEAD(estimate_hours, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY team ORDER BY work_day, item_id) < estimate_hours THEN 'lighter-next' ELSE 'same-next' END AS transition FROM work_items ORDER BY team, work_day, item_id
